{{Top|leg}}
This amendment to the [[Galactic Constitution/Legends|Galactic Constitution]] granted the [[Senator/Legends|senators]] of the Republic’s founding worlds — [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]], and [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] — the authority to exercise a veto over any vote passed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
